INSERT INTO base_peizhen_centre ( treatment_id, org_id, treat_start_time, treat_end_time, assistant_1, assistant_2, assistant_3, actualWorkload, refundWorkload ) VALUES
(#{item.treatmentId},#{item.orgId}, #{item.treatStartTime},#{item.treatEndTime}, #{item.assistant1}, #{item.assistant2}, #{item.assistant3}, #{item.actualWorkload}, #{item.refundWorkload})

SELECT btp.treatment_id as treatmentId, btp.org_id as orgId, btp.treat_start_time as treatStartTime, btp.treat_end_time as treatEndTime, assistant_1 as assistant1, assistant_2 as assistant2, assistant_3 as assistant3, IFNULL( bbd.actualWorkload, 0 ) AS actualWorkload, IFNULL( bf.refundWorkload, 0 ) AS refundWorkload FROM base_treatment_process btp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUM(bbd.originalAmount - bbd.discount_amount + bbd.swipe_workload) AS actualWorkload, bbd.treatment_id FROM ( SELECT bb.treatment_id, bbd.price * bbd.quantity AS originalAmount, bbd.swipe_workload, bbd.discount_amount FROM base_bill_detail bbd LEFT JOIN (select bb.treatment_id,bb.bill_id,bb.bill_date from base_bill bb where bb.bill_date is not null) bb ON bbd.bill_id = bb.bill_id ) bbd GROUP BY bbd.treatment_id ) bbd ON btp.treatment_id = bbd.treatment_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT br.treatment_id, SUM( br.refund_amount ) AS refundWorkload FROM base_refund br
GROUP BY br.treatment_id ) bf ON btp.treatment_id = bf.treatment_id where (assistant_1 is not null or assistant_2 is not null or assistant_3 is not null) and btp.treat_end_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY btp.treatment_id
